h: Tinubu approves inland dry port for Kebbi at campaign rally
p: President Tinubu has reportedly approved an inland dry port for Kebbi State, announcing it at an APC campaign rally in Birnin Kebbi. He also promised more road projects requested by Governor Nasir Idris.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly approved the creation of an inland dry port in Kebbi State, announcing the decision at an All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally in Birnin Kebbi on Tuesday, 17 November 2026.

Speaking to thousands of supporters at the Birnin Kebbi Stadium, the President thanked the people of the state for their support and praised Governor Nasir Idris. He is said to have approved several projects the governor had requested, including the dry port, and promised further road infrastructure for the state.
The Kebbi rally is part of the APC's presidential campaign ahead of the 16 January 2027 election.
more: The dry port was announced at the Birnin Kebbi rally.
Tinubu also promised more roads for Kebbi.
